rationale: Best-supported forced non-AI for the identified optional Workload Service Assurance feature: official HCL docs describe critical-job deadlines, job promotion and resource prioritization. HWA 10 also has suite-level AI anomaly-detection capabilities, but evidence does not attribute these to this feature; suite AI is not transferred without inclusion evidence.
version_scope: Record has no release/date; feature docs are Workload Automation 10.2.6. 'Milestone #8' is not treated as version evidence.
issues: Feature-specific documentation is not a complete suite inventory; broader HWA AI applicability to this feature and historical version are unresolved.

sources.excerpt: The workload service assurance feature is enabled and disabled by the global option enWorkloadServiceAssurance. It is enabled by default. ... calculates a critical start time ... A promoted job is assigned additional operating system resources and its submission is prioritized.
sources.applicability: HCL v10.2.6 documentation covers this named feature's conventional scheduling operation, not all product capabilities.

sources.excerpt: HWA 10 introduces AI-powered anomaly detection for workloads ... AI Data Advisory ... big data machine learning analytics technologies applied to the data from Workload Automation.
sources.applicability: Official broader-suite AI context; retained evidence does not link it to named Service Assurance feature.

sources.excerpt: Workload service assurance is an optional feature that allows you to identify critical jobs and to ensure that they are processed in a timely manner. (Milestone #8)
sources.applicability: Identifies the exact feature; does not supply product release/version.
